text:
olivia_support: FYI NovaPay (enterprise) opened a ticket: chat.generate p95 doubled starting ~2026-03-18 06:00 UTC. They see spikes ~1.8-2.2s -> 4s on some requests. Customer is asking for ETA to fix and whether we can route them to dedicated capacity.

devon_se: can you paste the logs and approximate query patterns? e.g., seq len, batch sizes, model?

olivia_support: pasted from ticket: model redwood/gptx-7b, typical seq_len 512, concurrent clients ~40, they say spikes correlate with longer context windows. Attached partial trace: 
```
[2026-03-18T06:12:02Z] req_id=ab12 svc=chat.generate latency=4123ms tokens=120 seq=512
[2026-03-18T06:12:03Z] req_id=ab13 svc=chat.generate latency=98ms tokens=12 seq=64
[2026-03-18T06:12:11Z] req_id=ab14 svc=chat.generate latency=3980ms tokens=136 seq=512
```

olivia_support: they also said they recently started using a long-history plugin that prepends ~20 system messages, so effective context grew.

mike_sre: interesting. Could be KV cache pressure or batching behavior falling back to single-token loops for some paths. Any correlated infra events?

ci-bot: deploy: service/worker-pool v3.4.8 rolled at 2026-03-17T23:50:12Z to region-us-west-2 by @deploy-bot (no failures reported).

mike_sre: that deploy timing matches the regression window. I'll grep for GC and OOM events and check GPU utilization.

devon_se: I'll try to reproduce with a synthetic load that mimics NovaPay's profile (40 concurrent, p50 seq 64, p95 seq 512, some long history). If I can repro we can iterate on mitigations.

jamal_pm: heads up product — NovaPay is on a committed Dedicated trial but currently on hosted fleet. They're asking both for a routing to Dedicated option and a timeline for a root-cause fix. They flagged this as P1.

sara_prod: thanks. For prioritization: is this a customer-specific configuration issue (support effort) or a platform-level regression that hits other customers? We should quantify blast radius before committing roadmap work.

anya_research: from model side, long-context and KV cache pressure can cause p95 jumps if KV eviction thrashes. We recently changed cache heuristics in v3.4.8 to tighter memory bounds. Might be running too aggressively and evicting between requests. I'll join the repro run.

mike_sre: quick findings: worker GC spikes at the same timestamps as high latencies. GPU utilization (compute) low during spikes, but CPU and PCIe copy queues high. Points to host-side stalls, likely memory churn.

devon_se: repro steps I used: 
```
ab-client --concurrency 40 --sequence-len-dist "p50:64,p95:512" --history-lines 20 --model redwood/gptx-7b --duration 15m
```
I reproduce p95 ~3.8-4.2s on latest prod image. When I reduce batching max_tokens from 256 -> 64 the p95 drops to ~1.1s but throughput drops ~25%.

sara_prod: good data. We need to triage two asks: (1) customer routing to Dedicated (short-term mitigation) (2) fix the regression / root cause (product+eng). Prioritization question: do we treat this as a reliability/regression (high priority) that slots into near-term sprint, or as a larger refactor (KV cache rewrite) that needs planning?

jamal_pm: commercial note: NovaPay is threatening throttling product launch if we don't provide a plan within 72h. That increases priority.

sara_prod: propose immediate runway: (A) Offer NovaPay dedicated pool routing for their critical traffic (ops change) — temporary, fast. (B) Engineering short-term mitigation: reduce default max_batch_tokens for affected fleet and add per-customer override. (C) Longer-term: schedule KV-cache heuristics rework + perf tests as a product initiative.

mike_sre: ops work (A) doable within hours — need billing/entitlements signoff. (B) low-risk config change, I'll open a change with canary. (C) requires design + perfbench; estimate 3-4 sprints for full rewrite.

devon_se: technical note: smaller batch cap reduces batching efficiency but eliminates cross-request memory churn. We should add a targeted canary that applies to NovaPay's label only, not global.

anya_research: for (C) I'll write an eval case that simulates their long-history plugin to measure p95 before/after heuristics. That will be a gating regression test.

sara_prod: launch criteria for the backlog item (KV cache rework): 
- Repro locally with synthetic harness and CI test.
- p95 improvement >= 30% for long-history workload without increasing p50 >10%.
- Automated regression test added to perf-suite.
- Rollout plan with canary + automatic rollback on p95 regression.

olivia_support: action items summarized for the ticket: 
- (mike_sre) route NovaPay to dedicated pool + confirm completion (ETA 4h).
- (mike_sre) change default max_batch_tokens in affected region canary (ETA 2h).
- (devon_se) reproduce and record perf diffs, push repro harness to repo (ETA EOD).
- (anya_research) draft perf test for long-history plugin (ETA 48h).
- (sara_prod) create product backlog epic and prioritize as P0 for next planning meeting (ETA 24h).

jamal_pm: I'll coordinate commercial communication and ask for written acceptance that dedicated routing is a stop-gap.

mike_sre: starting canary now. Will post status.

ci-bot: change: config/max_batch_tokens updated in region-us-west-2 canary by mike_sre at 2026-03-18T08:10:35Z.

mike_sre: canary looks good so far, p95 dropped to ~1.2s for NovaPay test stream. No spillover observed.

olivia_support: relaying to customer, they asked for timeline for permanent fix. I shared the launch criteria and that product has an epic in flight.

sara_prod: created epic "KV-cache heuristics + long-context stability" and set initial priority P0, linked dev tickets. Epic ID: RDW-7892. I'll put an initial scope note: quick heuristic rollback path + bench-driven refactor.

devon_se: uploaded repro harness to https://repo.internal/redwood/perf/novapay-repro and added run instructions.

anya_research: started drafting perf test, will open PR with baseline numbers.

mike_sre: follow-up note: we should monitor other customers with long-history plugins. I'll add a Grafana alert for host-side PCIe stalls and p95 delta > 1.5x.

sara_prod: ok team — solid plan. We'll treat this as both an SLA incident (support) and a product P0 to prevent recurrence. Keep updates in this thread.

olivia_support: closing the loop with NovaPay — they accepted dedicated routing for now and will wait for an official timeline. Marking ticket as "mitigated" in the interim.

mike_sre: done. marking canary healthy.

sara_prod: assigning owners in epic: devon_se (engineering lead), anya_research (perf lead), mike_sre (ops lead). Next sync in 24 hours.

jamal_pm: thanks everyone. I'll keep exec/commercial updated.
